title: Refund Ceiling on Premium Delivery Fees — Returns & Exchanges
content:
When original shipping is refunded on a Returns & Exchanges return, the fee refunded follows the delivery service the Online Orders order shipped by. Premium services are refunded no more than the list fee of the next service down.

| Delivery service of the order | Fee refunded |
|---|---|
| Next Business Day or Same-Day Courier | The fee charged, but at most the Expedited 2-Day list fee of 14.95 USD |
| Expedited 2-Day | The fee charged, but at most the Standard Ground list fee of 7.95 USD |
| Any other service (Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground) | The fee charged |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Service | Fee charged | Fee refunded |
|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courier | 24.95 | 14.95 |
| Next Business Day | 12.00 | 12.00 (below the ceiling) |
| Expedited 2-Day | 14.95 | 7.95 |
| Standard Ground | 7.95 | 7.95 |
